info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Payments Payments Capture-v5-spec
info.description: The Payments Capture API enables businesses to securely process and capture payment transactions in batches. This endpoint allows merchants and financial institutions to efficiently finalize payment authorizations and transfer funds, ensuring quicker access to revenue. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, payment processors, and financial services that need to automate payment workflows. This API supports seamless integration into existing systems to facilitate timely and accurate transaction management.

post.description: Initiates the process to capture an authorized payment transaction, finalizing the payment and transferring funds. This operation is crucial for merchants to complete sales and fulfill orders.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to capture a payment that has been previously authorized. It should contain the necessary details to execute the capture operation.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the requested payment capture.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number for tracking the payment transaction.

customer.description: The customer details associated with the payment.

resource.description: The resource identifier associated with the payment.

priority.description: The priority level of the payment request.

amount.description: The amount to be captured from the payment.

currency.description: The currency code for the payment amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether notification is required after processing.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the payment capture was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the payment capture request was made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record in the processing queue.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsCaptureRequest.description: Request body for capturing payments through the payment service.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates whether the customer is a VIP.

Customer.description: Details about the customer making the payment.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsCaptureResponse_20.title: Capture Payment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment capture operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the payment capture request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the payment capture operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment capture.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the payment capture in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the payment capture operation.

audit.description: Audit information for the payment capture operation.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsCaptureResponse_20.description: Response schema for the operation that captures a payment.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the payment capture was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details regarding the audit of the payment capture operation.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
